connectors.name: AniKoto
connectors.releaseNotes: Restores external English captions after AniKoto rotated subtitle delivery to cdn.kryntal.top and vidtub.akirax.buzz. The native four-step stream graph and media policy are unchanged.

connectors.name: AniKage (BETA)
connectors.releaseNotes: Beta candidate converted from the AniKage Player module. Uses the public AniKage JSON catalogue and selects the Kiwi provider, whose opaque source token is assembled into the fixed AniKage proxy URL with a native template transform. Kiwi returns an Apple HLS playlist with a finite child playlist in bounded live probes. Title fallback chains are bounded for Aroki schema compatibility. The Megg MP4 route was rejected because it can return stale or unauthorized sources and has returned MP4 bytes mislabeled as image/jpeg. External subtitles are intentionally not declared because the returned caption contract was inconsistent. Native iOS playback, file download, simulator, device, and AirPlay evidence remain unverified.

connectors.name: AnimeGG
connectors.releaseNotes: Declares honest per-episode Sub and Dub availability so unavailable audio is disabled before playback.

connectors.name: Update Flow Test
connectors.releaseNotes: Version 1.0.0 for validating Aroki's signed source-update flow.

connectors.name: One Pace
connectors.releaseNotes: M25: Consolidates One Pace into a single stable title on discovery and search. Increases concurrency to 4 workers and raises timeout to 30s so all 485+ episodes across all arcs load smoothly.

connectors.name: Synthetiq One
connectors.releaseNotes: Engineering opt-in connector v1.2.11 for the owner-operated Synthetiq One API. Adds the currently returned cdn.watching.onl and s1.akirax.buzz HLS hosts; native API-only search, details, episodes, discovery and DUB playback remain unchanged. No JavaScript, WebView or VPS changes.
